steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We've broken through the first defensive line!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What are the casters doing?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Even though there's only one enemy in the vanguard...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why are they just watching her tear us apart?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Hurry, hurry! Take her out!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka! You're getting out of range!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I can't... give you cover from here!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Do I look that reckless to you?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Watch your four o'clock!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Liskarm, it's time for your debut!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Be a sweetie and block the enemy's ranged attacks, won't you?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Quick! Faster!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Focus down the one with the sword first!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Did we get her--?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You call those attacks, or are you just throwing sticks and stones?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Woah!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Wh-where'd this one come from?!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I owe you one, Cap'n!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: My pleasure.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: However, Franka, your task was to launch a feint attack.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Instead, you fought your way all the way here. You have a huge target over your head now. Is that fine with you?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Sure is, after all, I have a trusty partner after all!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Ugh... Gahh...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka! You charged way too far ahead!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: See? She caught up to us.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm not used to this kind of stuff...! Why are you making me charge headlong into the enemy? I don't get it!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Curses...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: L.G.D. and Rhodes Island are working together!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: There's no way we can defend this place...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We can't afford to hesitate. It's do or die. Everyone, chaaarge!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The enemies are rushing straight at us!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Dieeeee!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If you plan to resist, you leave me with no choice. Don't take it personally.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You...!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaaaaaaaghhh!!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Madam, you're... quite strong.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That Reunion fellow... Not his lucky day.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They've got some nerve to attack us like that...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I feel bad for him.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They should apologize to those who died unjustly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Inspector!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm glad to see that you're all fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've collapsed their flank! The next step is to launch our all-out assault.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine by me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Everything seems to be going smoothly.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That probably won't last for much longer. The enemies have set up many obstacles, and are doing a good job of staying hidden.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Amiya, be prepared for a hard fight.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, make sure you scout things out thoroughly and protect your squads!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, let's go rescue Misha together!
